description: This file defines a feature for listing tags within an ASP.NET Core application, implementing CQRS pattern with MediatR. It contains a Query object and its handler to retrieve tags from the database.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Request object for retrieving tags, implements IRequest with a response of TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query to fetch tags from the database asynchronously using Entity Framework.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the tag listing request, querying the database and returning the tags wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.
